city_center.name: Downtown Memphis (Beale Street) + Memphis Farmers Market
city_center.landmark: Beale Street blues district and the Mississippi River bluff; Memphis Farmers Market in the South Main Arts District
city_center.notes: Mississippi Delta river city, home of the blues and Memphis-style barbecue. Kroger (dominant across TN) is the home grocer. Beale Street's old brick-and-tin-ceiling storefronts anchor the district. sources: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beale_Street; loc.gov Beale Street Historic District HABS.

cultural_notes: Memphis sits on the Mississippi River at the edge of the Delta; Beale Street is the birthplace and home of the blues, and Memphis-style barbecue is a defining regional food tradition (source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beale_Street; loc.gov Beale Street Historic District HABS; language selection flagged INFERRED)
Beale Street's historic fabric is old brick buildings with tin ceilings and loadbearing brick-masonry storefronts (source: facingsouth.org Beale Street; uzuncase.com adaptive reuse Memphis)

Delta agriculture gives the region strong root and summer-vegetable crops; Tennessee tomatoes run June through October and sweet potatoes are a fall harvest (source: bcbstwelltuned.com Tennessee tomato guide; picktnproducts.org)

The African-American musical and cultural heritage of Beale Street and Memphis is central to the city's identity and should be referenced respectfully (source: general cultural knowledge -- honor community, no endorsement implied)
